source.notes: The EBI archive contains 23 chromosome tables and its supplied SummaryOvarianResultsDescription.docx defines European analyses, with overall as all invasive. It defines Effect/Baseline, effect-allele EAF, R2_oncoarray, and a log-odds ratio (despite the overall_OR column name), SE and p-value. The source-specific materializer retains autosomal, source-explicit rsID A/C/G/T SNPs only. It materialized 14,936,299 of 19,911,988 source rows to ovarian_cancer.txt.gz (SHA-256 57a0b17ca9cbd513307d1bacceab279652ed824959fdff0dda83445fe4ee9e10); all excluded source-row categories are documented in docs/cancer_source_queue.md. The selected overall-invasive phenotype has 22,406 cases and 40,941 controls; the parent paper also reports 3,103 low-malignant-potential cases separately. No upstream checksum was supplied; this exact 3,774,309,689-byte public archive has the local SHA-256 registered here. The trait registry uses an explicit 1.1% US female lifetime-risk approximation for liability conversion.

resource_basis: Existing bounded curl transfers write bodies directly to SSD; observed curl RSS about8MiB each, small Python buffers
